text: {"lessons":["I will follow a written plan with position limits and scheduled reviews rather than letting frequent account checks dictate trades.","I will avoid panic-selling after steep declines, as I did with Stocks C and E; I will decide in advance what would change my view and when to exit.","I will not chase a stock after it rises, as I did when adding to Stock B at a higher price; I will assess each purchase against my allocation and risk limits."]}
